canonical_name: Minkowski triangle-inequality theorem family for Lp spaces
literal_source_claim_en: The triangle inequality in L^p space.
statement_blocker: The catalogue gives only the phrase 'the triangle inequality in L^p space'. It does not select an integral, eLpNorm, lpNorm, MemLp, or quotient-Lp formulation; fix the exponent type or infinity endpoint; identify the measure space or codomain; state measurability and integrability premises; or settle extended-infinite and a.e.-quotient cases. Pinned mathlib exposes several nonidentical candidates. Selecting one at intake without an admitted exact source and checked transports would invent proposition-changing choices.
domain_and_universes: Open: an approved source must fix a measurable space and measure, an exponent representation and endpoint regime, the scalar or vector codomain and its universe/typeclasses, and representative-functions versus a.e.-quotient Lp semantics.
conclusion: Prospective only: an Lp seminorm or norm of f + g is at most the sum of the corresponding seminorms or norms of f and g. The exact norm, domains, finiteness semantics, and proposition encoding are unresolved.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every boundary case listed in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_add_le for p : ENNReal with 1 <= p and AE-strongly-measurable functions
MeasureTheory.lpNorm_add_le with MemLp and real-valued seminorm output
the NormedAddCommGroup triangle law on MeasureTheory.Lp E p mu
ENNReal.lintegral_Lp_add_le as an explicit integral formula for nonnegative extended-real functions
finite-sum, countable-sum, real-valued, complex-valued, or general normed-codomain variants
excluded_substitutions: finite-sum or sequence-space Minkowski alone for a general measure-space Lp root
the p < 1 quasi-triangle estimate with a nonunit constant
Holder, Jensen, Young, or generalized mean inequalities alone
Minkowski convex-body theorem or Brunn-Minkowski inequality
Minkowski functional, Minkowski spacetime, Hasse-Minkowski, or number-field Minkowski bounds
a structure or hypothesis that assumes the desired triangle inequality
